chat_history.question: can you tell me about University
chat_history.answer:
The University mentioned in your document is the largest applied university in Finland, focusing on practical training and strong connections with businesses. It operates under the University of Applied Sciences model and has a wide international collaboration network. Its qualifications are recognized across Europe and many other countries.

In Vietnam, the university is implemented by FPT Education, which provides facilities, admissions, teaching organization, and business connections within the FPT ecosystem.

One of the training programs offered is in Smart Information Technology (CNTT Thông Minh), with specializations including Artificial Intelligence (AI).

Additionally, the university offers comprehensive support services for students aimed at personal development and enhancing the learning experience, including academic success support, career guidance, personal skill development, psychological counseling, student life activities, parent connections, and ongoing educational assistance throughout the learning process.
